accepted.concept: issue store reads an issue's Ask from jobs/
accepted.reason: An issue's Ask lives in its job record, and record.ts is its one writer. The buildable and sorted predicates read it with record.issueAsk; the edge is one read with no runtime cycle (improve S1, 2026-11-10).

accepted.concept: the issue verbs import Asks, the job record, the registry and recent repos
accepted.reason: issues.ts is the `aleph issue` verb layer: it sits above both the store and the factory's Asks and decides an Ask on close or drop, and writes the Asks a drop leaves (askAfterDrops, parkWaiter). The store itself imports only the job record, accepted above; it never imports asks/ask.ts (improve S1, 2026-11-10; refit f64).
keep-earn.ts runs in the target repo and imports nothing from aleph, so it keeps its own copy of unxml from checks.ts.

accepted.concept: the COMMANDS table rows of the aleph CLI
accepted.reason: COMMANDS is the one table of each command's usage and purpose. Its rows share one shape on purpose: help, --help and every usage refusal read the table, so each row is data, not a second way.

accepted.reason: Each refit skill ends its lens table with the same 'Report a candidate under one lens only.' line and opens the same Modes table, so a reader moves between them without a new layout. The text is a template, not logic (Chris, 2026-11-11).
